scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @oftmp/api" "npm run dev -w @oftmp/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @oftmp/shared && npm run build -w @oftmp/api && npm run build -w @oftmp/web
scripts.clean:install: npm run clean && npm cache clean --force && npm install
scripts.render:build:api: npm run render:install:api && npm run build -w @oftmp/shared && npm run build -w @oftmp/api
scripts.render:build:web: npm run render:install:web && npm run build -w @oftmp/shared && npm run build -w @oftmp/web
